name: nutrient
description: Parse, extract from and classify documents with Nutrient DWS: OCR for scans, Markdown with layout, structured fields with citations, and labels, as stored runs in your Nutrient account.

interface.longDescription: For people and teams who work with documents in ChatGPT or Codex: turn PDFs, Office documents and images into Markdown with layout, extract structured fields with citations for the values it finds, and classify documents with Nutrient DWS. Requires a Nutrient DWS account with credits: each run uses credits and is stored in your account. In ChatGPT, Nutrient takes files attached to the chat or HTTPS links; signing, redaction and other Processor operations need files on your computer, as in Codex. Uploaded files are kept for 24 hours.
defaultPrompt: Parse the attached PDF into Markdown with Nutrient
Extract the invoice number, seller and total from this invoice with Nutrient

positive.description: Extract invoice fields from a PDF link
positive.prompt: Extract the invoice number, invoice date and total from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSPDFKit/pspdfkit-maui-catalog/main/Resources/Raw/Assets/invoice.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: Nutrient extracts the invoice number 19431-781, the date March 12, 2024 and the total 2,720 € from page 1, each with a citation. The Nutrient panel lists the values, and Review shows the page with each value highlighted.

positive.description: Convert an attached PDF to Markdown
positive.prompt: Convert the attached menu to Markdown with Nutrient.
positive.expected_behavior: Nutrient parses the attached PDF and returns its text as Markdown, keeping the menu's sections, dishes and prices in reading order. The Nutrient panel shows the result.

positive.prompt: With Nutrient, is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSPDFKit/pspdfkit-maui-catalog/main/Resources/Raw/Assets/default.pdf a contract, an invoice or a form?
positive.expected_behavior: Nutrient labels the document a contract with a confidence score, and the answer names that label.

positive.description: Draft an extraction schema without processing a document
positive.prompt: With Nutrient, draft an extraction schema for purchase orders: order number, order date, supplier, and line items with quantity and unit price. Don't run it on a document yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Nutrient returns a JSON schema with the requested fields and an array of line items. No document is processed.

positive.prompt: How many Nutrient Data Extraction credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Nutrient reports the Data Extraction credits used and remaining in the signed-in account's current billing period.

negative.description: A general question with no document, which Nutrient isn't needed for
negative.prompt: Suggest three names for a coffee shop.

negative.description: Deleting account data, which Nutrient's tools can't do
negative.prompt: Delete every document stored in my Nutrient account.

negative.description: Signing a document, which Nutrient doesn't offer in ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Sign the attached contract with my name, Jane Doe.

review.commerce_description: Nutrient sells nothing in ChatGPT. Runs use the credits of the user's existing Nutrient DWS account.

publication.release_notes: First release: parse PDFs, Office documents and images into Markdown with layout, extract fields with citations, and classify documents with your Nutrient DWS account, then review each value on its page in the Nutrient panel.
